summary: Brookfield Business Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing a report of voting results from its annual meeting of shareholders held June 18, 2026. All seven director nominees were elected by acclamation, and the reappointment of Deloitte LLP as auditor was approved. Class A Shares held a 25% aggregate voting interest and Class B Shares held 75%. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring, was disclosed. This is a routine report of annual meeting outcomes and does not constitute a special situation.
